newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's economy grows 5.5 pct in third quarter.
newsitem.headline: Chile's economy grows 5.5 pct in third quarter.

text.p: Chile's gross domestic product expanded 5.5 percent in the third quarter this year against the same period 1995 with the economy growing 6.9 percent in the first nine months of 1996, the central bank said.
The third quarter figure reflected strong growth in the mining, construction and telecommunications sectors, the bank's fortnightly report said.
This contrasted sharply with the poor performance of the agricultural and electricity sectors which have been badly hurt by this year's drought, it said.
The bank figures showed the economy was on track to meet the government's target of seven percent economic growth this year.

Internal demand grew 2.7 percent in the third quarter as a result of lower spending on industrial machinery and equipment, which was affected by a slowdown in growth of capital goods imports, said the bank.

Overall consumer spending rose 6.5 percent in the third quarter compared with the same period last year, reflecting "the process of normalization which this figure has showed over this year," said the bank.
